verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a first-party one-line PostHog export explicitly for custom dashboards (helicone-gh-2), so custom dashboards are possible but are built in PostHog rather than in Helicone. Natively it offers a fixed dashboard tracking usage, costs, and performance (helicone-docs-42), HQL/SQL querying over request data (helicone-docs-33, helicone-comm-17), and charts that users report finding useful (helicone-comm-3-refresh-8dd2a8a90d9cf707). Response scoring exists only via webhooks (helicone-docs-23). missing for 10: a native in-product custom dashboard builder, documented charting of eval-score metrics, explicit latency and error-rate panels, and hands-on corroboration of custom dashboard building.
